reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

I took it from the incident channel's history, which Tobias can see himself because he's a member. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka reported that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her note at 18:43 said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

The channel doesn't give a street address for the site. I also found no account files for Tansley in the shared files, so if he needs more than the depot name, I couldn't find it.
